The '''DL-21''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] at some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Description==
[[File:DL21BlasterPistol-BtM.png|thumb|left|200px|A modified DL-21 owned by [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]]]]
The DL-21 was similar in appearance to other BlasTech pistols, such as the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. However, this version featured a flared muzzle, which produced scattered energy charges. It also featured a top-mounted targeting scope, and a safety lever inside the trigger guard.

==History==
Since BlasTech refused to enter into an exclusive agreement with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], many of its weapons fell into the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. A number of DL-21 pistols were used by Rebel forces during the invasion of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], and at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] a [[4 ABY/Legends|year later]] in the hands of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Renz/Legends|Renz]]. [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] was seen with a holstered DL-21 onboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]] also carried a modified DL-21 during his partnership with [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]]. This particular [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] lacked a safety mechanism, and included cooling vents on the flared muzzle, and a comfortable hand grip suitable for [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] hands. Several [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], most notably [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dyer/Legends|Dyer]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Renz/Legends|Renz]] used theses models but lacked the finned muzzle.
